model_output.rationale: 271 returns EB*R for Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B FFS with message "PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER." Claim was filed CI/primary to Delaware Valley Mutual. Route: bill Medicare Part B first, then rebill DVM as secondary with primary EOB data.

root_cause.explanation: 271 shows EB*R for Novitas Medicare Part B FFS marked primary payer. Claim sent to Delaware Valley Mutual as primary (SBR responsibility P). CO-22 on all lines; MOA MA04 confirms primary adjudication data absent.

next_action.detail: Bill Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B (payer ID 1846349352) as primary. After Medicare adjudicates, rebill Delaware Valley Mutual as secondary: populate SBR01=S, 2320 SBR/AMT/CAS with Medicare's paid amount and adjustments, line SVD/CAS per TR3 §6.

citations.rule: CARC 22 alone → resubmit_other_payer; never appeal a disclaiming payer. MA04 confirms primary adjudication data missing — supply it when rebilling as secondary.
CO = provider liable, never bill patient; CARC 22 with OA/CO and EB*R → coverage active, misordered, not billable to patient.
